tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /byang gter rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi smin byed chog khrigs rgyud gsum dbang byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /byang gter rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi smin byed chog khrigs rgyud gsum dbang byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// byang gter rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi smin byed chog khrigs rgyud gsum dbang byed ces bya ba bzhugs so//

'khor 'das dbang sgyur gsung mchog pad+ma'i zhal// chos rgyal gdung rgyud skyob phyir rtsod pa'i mthar// mthing smug dbang gi mdog can skur bzhengs pa// brgyud par bcas la sgo gsum gus pas 'dud// lha brag zangs mdzod nas byon pa'i// snod bcud dbang byed rten 'brel gyi// chos bdun nang tshan yi dam lha// dregs pa dbang sdud smin byed bkod//

'di la sbyor ba dkyil 'khor dbus su gru gsum dmar nag zla gam gsum/ 'khor lo phyogs mdog can rtsibs bzhi pa gru chad bar khyams sgo bzhi rta babs rim bzhi/ khor yug rdor ra me ri sogs bri/ pad ra dur khrod gzhung las ma bshad pas mi dgos/ ras bris sogs med na maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu dmar po gcig bkod pa'i khar mañdzi'i steng du dpal bshos dmar po rta mgo rgyan spros me ri lha tsaka gtor gdugs dmar po sogs kyis mtshan pa bkod/ shar du rnam bum bcud dang rgyan ldan/ lhor gsang rdzas bdud rtsi'i thod pa/ nub tu sher dbang me long*/ byang du bka' srung thang lha'i gtor ma/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka /phyi mchod bskor bsham/ sngon gtor tshogs mchod/ mig dar me tog sogs kyang 'du bya'o// dngos gzhi thog mar bdag mdun sgrub pa ni/ tshig bdun brgyud 'debs nas/ phrin las dgos 'dod kun 'byung ltar skyabs sems/ bgegs gtor bsang sbyang byin rlabs spyi ltar la/
saṃ bhā ra
'i sngags kyis bsngo/

hūm̐: yang dag don la mi mos pa: mi dang mi min log 'dren bgegs: lan chags glud gtor 'di khyer la: gnas 'dir khor yug tshun chad du: skad cig tsam yang 'da' ma byed: gal te nga yi bka' 'das na: bde gshegs khro bo kun 'dus nas: khyod kyi lus ngag rdul du rlog:

ces pa dang*/ phrin las gzhung gi bka' bsgo ba nas brtsam bstod pa'i bar btang*/ dzap bzlas kyi skabs gtso bor ka dag gi lta ba'i ngang nas bzla ba dang*/ spyi mthun bdag byin rlabs pa sogs bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i dmigs pa'ang sbyor chog cing*/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi rtsa sgrub las gsungs pa'i rta skad thengs gsum dang*/ gdug pa can kha bcing ba'i ting nge 'dzin yang ci rigs par sbyor/ bdag mdun dbyer med kho na bya chog cing rtogs pas mi chun na dzap khang spyi ltar dbye zhing*/ mthar bum nang skad cig gis dkyil 'khor gsal btab la dzap bzlas 'phro 'du 'ang spyi ltar byas la/ bdag mdun spyi la dmigs pa'i stong tshigs mchod bstod 'bul/ 'bru gsum gyis mchod yon phul nas 'od zhu bya/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gsal btab la de'i sngags kyis byin brlab/ bka' srung gtor 'bul/ tshogs byin rlabs nas bsgral bstab yan song ba dang rig pa'i me tog dor ro// de nas dbang bskur ba la slob ma rnams khrus nas dbyung*/ bgegs gtor
raṃ yaṃ khaṃ
dang 'bru gsum gyis bsang sbyang*/
sam+bha ra
gsum gyis bsngo/ gong gsal/
hūm̐: yang dag don la
sogs dang*/

na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ yi dam khro bo'i rgyal po dbang chen rta mchog rol pa dregs pa dbang sdud kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ rdo rje'i slob ma rnams la byin rlabs smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo bgyid pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la sa yi phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro ba rnams lus ngag thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bgyi'o//
zhes pas bgegs gtor btang zhing*/ las byang ltar/
hrī: rig pa ye shes
sogs kyis bka' bsgo /
hrī: bdag nyid dpal chen
sogs kyis mtshams bcad la srung 'khor bsgom/ maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal btab la/

de la bka' gter dag snang gi bka' srol las byon pa'i dbang chen rta mgrin dmar nag gi sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus mtha' yas pa zhig bzhugs pa las byin rlabs myur zhing zab pa/ khyad par dregs byed gdug can gyi rigs su gyur pa mtha' dag dang po kha bcing zhing zil gyis gnon/ bar du dbang du 'du zhing bka' la nyan/ tha ma phrin las ci bcol sgrub pa'i thabs khyad par du 'phags pa 'di ni/ slob dpon chen pos chos rgyal khri srong gi bzhed pa sgrub cing bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir du dbang chen 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi bcud phyungs nas mdzad de zang zang lha brag tu sbas pa/ phyis gter ston rig 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis spyan drangs pa nub zangs mdzod dmar po'i chos sde/ gdul bya dbang byed rten 'brel chos bdun gyi nang tshan tsan dan gyi sdong po lta bu yi dam gyi skor du gtogs pa yin cing*/ de la'ang rta mgrin 'khor 'das dbang sdud dang dregs pa dbang sdud gnyis su mchis pa las phyi ma'i smin byed sgrub pa skabs su babs pa ste
sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /
dkyil 'khor ma mthong bar mtshon phyir ras yug dmar pos gdong bcings par mos shig /a khaṃ bī ra hum̐:
thung ngus mig dar sbyin/
lha dang mjal ba'i phyag rten du me tog gi phreng ba thogs par mos shig /ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐:
ring pos me tog gtad/

thal mo me tog dang bcas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos/ kye: 'gro ba'i mgon po ston pa bla na med: bde gshegs kun 'dus bdag la dgongs su gsol: ma rig las kyis mnar ba'i sems can la: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang mchog bskur du gsol:
lan gsum/

kye: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod bdag la gson: gsang ba mchog 'di rab tu gnyan pas na: mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig bsrung nus sam: de ltar khas len bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin: bla mas ji ltar bka' bsgos pa las nam yang mi 'da' bar dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung ba'i blos rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung ba dang lhan cig 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/
dam chu sbyin la/
sa ma ya i dan na ra kan:
zhes brjod du gzhug /

mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag sogs mkha' khyab kyi mar gyur sems can thams cad skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i 'dun pas rjes zlos/ na mo: dus gsum sangs rgyas
sogs las byang ltar lan gsum bya/
de nas byin dbab pa'i slad du gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye ho: bla ma bde gshegs rgyal ba thams cad kyi: byin rlabs ye shes bdag la dbab tu gsol:
lan gsum/
dbang gi gzhi 'god pa ye shes pa dbab pa la dmigs pa 'di ltar du sgoms shig /oṃ badz+ra a mṛta
sa bsang*/
swa bhā ba
sa sbyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang gi rnam smin sha khrag gi phung po 'di nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams tha mal du gsal ba'i snying gar hrīḥyig dmar po gsal 'tsher bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa zhig gsal btab pa'i 'od zer gyis/ phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa sbyangs te hrīḥdamar por gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba las khyed rang rnams rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bye ru'i lhun po la nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khyud pa ltar dmar zhing 'tsher ba/ g.yas kyi phyag rgyas gzugs khams 'degs shing*/ g.yon gyi phyag rgyas 'dod khams sa gzhir gnon pa/ dbu tshangs pa'i yul rtser sleb cing ri rab lhun po la sku'i stegs byas pa/ nyi zla gza' skar rked la 'khor zhing zhabs rgya mtsho'i gting du brkyangs pas gza' klu rgyal 'gong dam sri the'u rang gshin rje 'byung po rnams gnon pa/ dbu gtsug ral pa'i gseb nas rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad g.yas g.yon steng 'og tu thengs gsum gsum sgrog pas srid pa'i pho rgyud mo rgyud gza' klu thams cad dbang du sdud pa/ hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa gsum gyis drag sngags 'brug stong dus gcig tu grags pa ltar bsgrags pas khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i skur gsal ba'i/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/

thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po dang hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa dang*/ slob dpon yang der gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min dbang drag rol pa dang lho nub dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod la sogs pa nas dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs char babs pa ltar byon nas khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par mos shig /
spos rol dbyangs dang bcas/
hrī: lho nub dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas: khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dbang gi lha: bde gshegs khro bo'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: thugs rjes brtser dgongs gnas 'dir byin phob cig:
rtsa sngags dang*/
hrīḥhrīḥhrī:
zhes brjod la byin dbab/
ye shes pa brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod// tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/
spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag /
de nas sngon du byin pa'i me tog gi phreng ba de lhag pa'i lha la phul snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas te 'bul bar zhu/ puṣ+pe sid+dhi hūm̐:
zhes me tog 'bul du gzhug /
de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid dkyil 'khor nas blangs te mgo bor lan gsum dkris pas dbang dang po me tog phreng ba'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ puṣ+pe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:
zhes sbyin/

ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs mig dar dang lhan cig bsal bas dag pa ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ legs 'ong bu khyod skal bar ldan: ma rig ling thog nga yis bsal: rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor ltos: dam tshig rtse gcig thub par srungs: dz+nyā na tsak+ṣuḥpra be sha ya phaṭa:
ces mig thur gyis gdong bsal/

rten gzhal yas khang dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ brten pa ye shes kyi lha rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud dam can srung ma'i 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum du mjal ba'i mos pas dad spro skyed cig /
bum dbang ni/

bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas bum pa'i dbang bskur ba tsam gyis bum pa'i bdud rtsis khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi nang gang*/ sgrib pa bzhi dag /sku bzhi mngon du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/
rnam bum thogs la/

hrī: rin chen bum pa mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs nang: dag byed ye shes bdud rtsi lha yi chu: bde gshegs dbang chen 'dus pa'i bum pa 'dis: skal ldan dbang bskur dbang bzhi'i snod gyur cig: hrīḥka lā sha kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:
zhes dbang bskur zhing bum chu sbyin/

na mo/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang yi dam khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rigs kyi bu 'di nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phob la/ dus da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis rlobs shig /mthun rkyen smon pa'i legs tshogs thams cad myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig /mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol//
rtsa sngags mthar/
ā be sha ya a āḥ
btags pa brjod la byin dbab spos dang ḍā dril 'khrol la/
de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur bas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no//
gsang dbang ni/
bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang 'od kyi rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems bdud rtsis dbang bskur bar mos shig /
thod pa mgrin par gtugs la/

hrī: chos sku snang mtha'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: longs spyod rdzogs sku snang tshul cir yang ston: sprul sku khro rgyal rta mgrin dbang gi lha: kun 'dus byang sems bdud rtsis dbang bskur ro: hrīḥbo dhi tsit+ta a mṛta wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:
zhes bdud rtsi blud/

bdud rtsi myang bas rtsa khams thams cad dkar dmar byang chub sems kyis khyab/ 'ching byed kyi mdud pa grol/ ngag rlung ā li kā li'i sngags kyi rang sgrar smin par mos shig /de ltar gsang ba'i dbang bskur pas ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs/ lam rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no//
sher dbang ni/ me long snying gar gtad la/

me long 'dis mtshon byed du byas nas rang snang ye shes kyi rig ma lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba'i rten du gyur pas dbang bskur bar mos shig /hrī: reg bya'i bde ba 'jam zhing yid du 'ong: stong gsal mnyam yangs ye shes gsal 'grib med: sna tshogs 'char ba shes rab dbang mchog 'di: skal ldan gsang sngags dam par dbang bskur ro: hrīḥkarma mu dra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'du shes gsum dang ldan pas thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pa las yas bab dang mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi'i rim pas lhan skyes bde stong zung 'jug nyams su myong bar mos shig /de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur pas yid kyi sgrib pa dag /thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la zhugs/ lam rdzogs pa chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no//
gtor dbang ni/

gtor snod dur khrod rngam brjid rol pa'i gzhal yas su/ gtor ma khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i sku dngos su gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung ba khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum du thim pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs/ ka dag nam mkha' lta bu'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hrī: snod bcud rnam dag rten dang brten par bcas: rang lus phung khams dang bcas gzhal yas khang: don dam rig stong 'gyur med bzhi pa'i dbang: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: hrīḥti la ka dz+nyā na ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

zhes dbang bskur/ 'dir gtor ma'i bka' bsgo mdzad pa'i phyag srol yod 'dug kyang skabs don min pas phyis byung du mngon la/ spro na brgyud pa'i mtshan nas brjod de bka' bsgo spyi ltar bya ba nyid do/ gang ltar mthar/

'di ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad rang gi rig pa'i rtsal las grub par shes pa mdzod la/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'od du zhu nas gtor ma'i gzhal yas khang la thim/ nang bcud kyi sems can rang lus dang bcas pa gtor ma'i lha la thim/ de'ang gzhal yas khang rim bzhin 'od du zhu ba gtor ma'i lha la thim/ lha yi dbu zhabs nas rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i hrīḥl bsdu/ hrīḥde nyid rim bzhin 'ja' ltar yal nas dmigs med spros bral gyi don la mnyam par zhog cig /
ces dar gcig bzhag la/

des dbang bzhi pa rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob/ sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag /sku gsum gyi byin rlabs lus ngag yid gsum la zhugs/ lam de kho na nyid kyi don bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa yin no//
zhes brjod/ rtsa bar skabs 'dir bka' srung gi gtad rgya byed par gsungs pa ni slob ma gzhan don nus pa la gud du bya dgos kyi dkyus su mi mdzad do//

de'ang rang gzhung las/ chos zab pad+ma'i snying khrag dwangs ma 'di: rang gi mig dang snying las gces gyur kyang: ma 'ongs phyi ma bzhi bcu kha ral dus: dam sri sde brgyad rdul du brlag pa dang: 'gro ba mchog dman gang gis nyams blangs kyang: phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar nges: zhes gsungs pa ltar tshe 'dir bar chad sel ba la mchog tu bsngags shing phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar byed pa/ rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi rtsa ba'i dbang bskur legs par grub pa yin pas

sogs kyis mtshams sbyar la dam tshig gzung ba phyin chad spyi ltar bya'o// rjes lhag ma gtang ba sogs las byang ltar la/ rta bro'i rjes su mchod bstod nongs bshags bsdu ldang bsngo smon shis brjod rnams kyis mtha' brgyan no// dregs pa dbang 'dus gang bsam las// 'grub cing rigs bdag zhing mchog tu// tshe gcig byang chub la sbyor ba'i// bden gsungs bslu ba med 'grub shog /ces pa'ang rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dang rnam dbyer med pa'i 'dren mchog rnam pa gsum gyi gsung gi bdud rtsi la longs spyod pa pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis dpal spungs yang khrod tsa 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //
